name: neowiki_rebuild_runs
comment: One row per graph rebuild run. A run reprojects the wiki into exactly one graph store, so rebuilding every store is one row each. The row carries the progress a resumed run picks up from, and outlives the run as its record.

columns.name: nwrr_store
columns.comment: Name of the graph store this run rebuilds, as configured (see SparqlStoreConfig::$name and Neo4jPlugin::STORE_NAME)

columns.name: nwrr_status
columns.comment: queued, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled

columns.name: nwrr_phase
columns.comment: Which half of the rebuild the run is in: pages (reprojecting the wiki's pages) or deletions (removing the pages MediaWiki no longer has). The cursor is a position within this phase.

columns.name: nwrr_cursor
columns.comment: Page id the run last dealt with in its current phase. A resumed run continues after it. 0 before the phase has read a page.

columns.name: nwrr_processed
columns.comment: Pages projected into the store so far

columns.name: nwrr_failed
columns.comment: Pages the run could not reconcile, having failed to project or to remove them

columns.name: nwrr_trigger
columns.comment: What started the run: cli, api, ui or auto

columns.name: nwrr_finished
columns.comment: When the run reached a terminal status. Null while it is running.

columns.name: nwrr_error
columns.comment: The store-level error that failed the run. Null unless it failed.

indexes.name: nwrr_store_started
indexes.comment: Index for finding a store's active run, and its most recent one
